name: CATALYST [ACT 3]
source:
A story about two brothers on the opposite sides of a planet wide conflict.

This is the conclusion to the tale which can be found on [url=https://www.questden.org/wiki/Catalyst]Questden[/url].

[From Itch.io]
translation:
一場席捲整顆星球的衝突，讓一對兄弟站到了對立面。

這個故事可在[url=https://www.questden.org/wiki/Catalyst]Questden[/url]讀到，本作是它的終章。
